category: Pimp my project in the newsletter, please
message:
Hi b3ta,

I made Take The Wall: one web page with one owner at a time. Put up a project or message and the next takeover replaces it for everyone. It is a small internet experiment: what would you put on a page that somebody else can overwrite?

https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=b3ta&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=shared_page&utm_content=project_submission

Watching and previewing are free. Publishing a takeover costs $3.99, with no guaranteed audience or duration. I am submitting the project for editorial consideration, not asking to sponsor the newsletter.

A 15-second recording of the real preview, using example content (no payment or activation shown):
